title: Earthy Dutch Pea Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup made with earthy mushrooms, dutch peas, and aromatic broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the frozen peas, vegetable broth, and 4 cups of water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the peas are tender.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
